issues.issue: Did the Officer unreasonably apply the PGWP-PDI criteria as mandatory to refuse a second post-graduate work permit?
issues.applicant_position: Officer fettered discretion by treating PGWP-PDI as law, ignored unique circumstances; officers can issue a second PGWP in special circumstances.
issues.respondent_position: PGWP-PDI are mandatory and officers cannot waive them.
issues.result_text: Minister may set criteria under IRPR s. 205; Officer reasonably applied them and there was no procedural fairness breach.

issues.issue: Was there a breach of legitimate expectation based on the 2012 phone advice?
issues.applicant_position: Phone advice in 2012 created a legitimate expectation of a second PGWP.
issues.respondent_position: Legitimate expectation cannot extend substantive rights to the applicant.
issues.result_text: Officer was not told of the 2012 conversation, so applicant cannot now argue the Officer erred in not considering it.

issues.issue: Should the proposed question on fettering of discretion be certified?
issues.applicant_position: Asks to certify whether applying PGWP-PDI as mandatory fetters a visa officer's discretion.
issues.result_text: Request to certify the question is denied; Zhang criteria not met.
